runs.label: near-clouds
runs.prompt: The attached painting shows the exact style: a heroic early 20th-century illustration oil painting with deep blue sky, hard sunlight and sculpted white clouds with crisp confident brushwork. Paint only a bank of big billowing white cumulus clouds in exactly that style and lighting (sunlight from the upper left, blue-grey shadows), filling the bottom 45 percent of a wide frame from the left edge to the right edge, with a rich, irregular billowing top edge. Everything above the clouds is fully transparent: no sky, no horse, no wings, nothing else. No text, no border.
